protocol_variants.title: Cell with 0.2 M copper sulphate
protocol_variants.sample_policy: Independent protocol; do not concatenate with other variants. Within this protocol preserve each named sample; new aliquots/trials need separate state tracks and reference images.
notes: Source conflict: materials list starts CuSO4 at 0.25 M; procedure and Table 4.1 specify 0.2 M. These variants follow procedure/table; teacher review pending.

procedure_steps.instruction: Set up separate zinc/1 M zinc sulphate and copper/0.2 M copper sulphate half-cells with 50 mL beakers.
procedure_steps.observation: Two half-cells are connected through a salt bridge; copper electrolyte is blue.

quantities.note: Materials list, not a separately specified procedural transfer.

procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Measure potential and polarity with the bridge in place.
procedure_steps.observation: Record measured potential; do not fabricate a reading.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.

procedure_steps.instruction: Remove the salt bridge after measurement. Replace the copper half-cell with a separately prepared concentration for the next trial.
procedure_steps.observation: This is a replacement beaker, not a top-up of the prior half-cell.
procedure_steps.quantity_constraint: Use only the stated dose for this sample. Unknown doses remain unset; do not substitute equal additions or convert drops to mL.
